title: HandoffPackage
description: Structured package for agent-to-agent handoff. The receiver MUST validate against this schema before processing.

goal.description: Clear task objective in natural language.

context_refs.description: URIs or links to artifacts and semantic layer entities (not text copies).

decisions_made.description: Prior decisions (ADR) that must not be violated.

open_questions.description: Questions requiring resolution by the receiving agent.

expected_output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the expected result.
